transfer_taxes.name: San Diego County documentary transfer tax
transfer_taxes.source_title: San Diego County Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk: Recording
transfer_taxes.notes: $0.55 per $500 (R&T 11911). Collected 'for the county and cities'; under R&T 11911(b)-(c) a city tax of half the county rate is credited against the county tax, so no net additional city tax. No separate City of San Diego tax found. Payer customary/negotiable (seller assumed; a non-official guide says it is often split).
